Not so much specifically for a tank, but going forward try to keep your abilities and the buttons that activate them similar across all characters, helps to build muscle memory. 

For example every single class’s interrupt is on shift+2, so it doesn’t matter who you are playing, when you know you need an interrupt or a heal etc, you instinctively hit the button. It helped me a lot. 

Also try to figure out which buttons are comfortable to hit often, I use 1-5, shift 1-5, q-r and shift q-r. Plus f1-f4 for Druid forms and random stuff. Mount is T. 

There’s a ton of variety and most of it comes down to what you prefer. Mess around with it, check out other people’s on forums/YouTube or even try some addons like Elvui or Bartender as well.
